original:
For completeness, two root inequalities used in these systems are recorded
here. If $x_{1}<\cdots<x_{m}$ are the roots of $f$ and
 $y_{1}<\cdots<y_{m-1}$ those of $f^{\prime}$ , then, for $m\geq 3$ ,

 $\frac{(m-k)x_{k}+x_{k+1}}{m-k+1}<y_{k}<\frac{x_{k}+kx_{k+1}}{k+1}\quad(1\leq k<m).$ 

(5)
